WITH pending AS (
  SELECT
    ia.item_id,
    i.fetched_at,
    (
      COALESCE(ia.d1_policy, 0) >= 85
      OR COALESCE(ia.d2_chain, 0) >= 85
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM item_entities ie
        JOIN entities e ON e.id = ie.entity_id
        WHERE ie.item_id = ia.item_id
          AND e.circle = 'C1'
      )
    ) AS priority
  FROM item_analysis ia
  JOIN items i ON i.id = ia.item_id
  WHERE ia.quota_state = 'pending_over_quota'
)
SELECT
  now() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority AND fetched_at < now() - INTERVAL '24 hours')::float / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority)
  END AS value
FROM pending
SELECT now() AS time, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM item_analysis WHERE summary_zh = '[需人工脱敏]'
SELECT now() AS time, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM merge_conflicts WHERE status = 'pending'
